summary: The North Face Corridor stops at its south side; muography confirms no structure >1m x 1m continues further south. It does NOT connect to the Big Void or other chambers.
content: Procureur et al. (Nature Communications 2023): the North Face Corridor (NFC) is a rectangular cuboid ~2.02m wide, 2.18m high, 9.06m long. 'The NFC appears to stop at the South side and simulation confirmed that there is no structure with a cross section of more than 1 m x 1 m further on the South.' The corridor is a discrete, sealed void behind the Chevron; it does not connect to the Big Void or other known chambers. Its function remains unknown but it is not a through-ramp.
